verdict.rationale: Shopify lets users reach it through natural language mostly indirectly: external AI assistants connect via official MCP servers (Storefront, Catalog, Cart, Checkout, Order), and the AI Toolkit gives AI coding tools access to docs, schemas and CLI store management. That covers buyer-side commerce flows and developer workflows, but not direct natural-language operation of the merchant admin. The only first-party conversational signal is a thin 'Design fast with AI' tagline. missing for 10: a documented first-party natural-language interface for operating the store/admin, NL coverage of merchant tasks beyond buyer shopping and dev tooling, independent or hands-on corroboration.
